<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pos(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            out[n['color']]=(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][0][1])
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][1]<20 and n['pixels']>=12:
            out['SQ']=list(n['boundary'][0])
    return out
def tip(fr):
    asc=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    sq=[n for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][1]<20 and n['pixels']>=12][0]
    r0=sq['boundary'][0][0]
    for r in range(r0,r0+6):
        idx=[c for c in range(16,48) if asc[r][c] in 'wgW']
        if idx: return (r,min(idx),max(idx))
print("BEFORE:",pos(current_frame),"tip:",tip(current_frame))
res=action(['LEFT'],intent='explore')
print("AFTER LEFT:",pos(current_frame),"tip:",tip(current_frame))
print("result:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pos(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            out[n['color']]=(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][0][1])
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][1]<20 and n['pixels']>=12:
            out['SQ']=list(n['boundary'][0])
    return out
def tip(fr):
    asc=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    sq=[n for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][1]<20 and n['pixels']>=12][0]
    r0=sq['boundary'][0][0]
    for r in range(r0,r0+6):
        idx=[c for c in range(16,48) if asc[r][c] in 'wgW']
        if idx: return (r,min(idx),max(idx))
print("BEFORE:",pos(current_frame),"tip:",tip(current_frame))
res=action(['LEFT'],intent='explore')
print("AFTER LEFT:",pos(current_frame),"tip:",tip(current_frame))
print("result:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
